title: English clubs' Champions League scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League goals for English clubs since 1992/93 (goals for more than one English club add together).
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Robin van Persie: Robin van Persie is just outside with 25 (18 for Arsenal, 7 for Man Utd).
notes.Cristiano Ronaldo: Cristiano Ronaldo scored 21 for Man Utd.

checks: Sum of goals for Man Utd, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Man City, Spurs, Newcastle, Leeds, Leicester, Aston Villa and Blackburn in every season, from UEFA.com season stats and Transfermarkt season scorer lists; both agree on every figure. Sterling is 24 for Man City and 3 for Chelsea; Jesus is 20 for Man City and 6 for Arsenal.
